# Torznab fixtures

Synthetic responses in the Jackett v0.24.2856 format (shape checked during the 5.1 spike, 2026-10-15: `caps`,
results with `torznab:attr` `seeders/peers/infohash/magneturl/imdbid`, the `<error code="100">` error). Titles,
hashes and links are made up; no real indexer results are stored in the repository.
